messages:
maya (head of growth): FYI Reuters just DM'd asking for a short CEO line + embargo time. Said they may run a tiny preview if we give a quote. Can we provide a holding line?

diego (pr): What's the embargo on the blog again?

sarah (content): It's set for 07:00 PT tomorrow. No earlier.

leo (product): Fine to give a holding line but must avoid any comparative claims or raw numbers.

frank (legal): I can sign off on a 1-line quote if it's noncommittal. Need it in plain language, no superlatives.

maya (head of growth): Draft: "These benchmarks reflect work to improve inference latency and per-token cost across common deployment patterns." Short, neutral.

sarah (content): Nice. Add an extra sentence for method: "We measured end-to-end latency across regions using consistent routing and batch-aware configs."

frank (legal): Tweak: change "batch-aware" -> "batch-aware execution" and "common deployment patterns" -> "deployment patterns we commonly see". Approving otherwise.

diego (pr): I'll send under embargo with explicit request not to publish raw tables early. Using template below.

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Queued email to reporter (ID: 2026-03-24-RTR-11).

--- email body (for PR to send) ---
Per embargo, content is not for publication or attribution until 07:00 PT on <date>. The following quote and methodology are approved for use at embargo lift.

Quote: "These benchmarks reflect work to improve inference latency and per-token cost across deployment patterns we commonly see."

Methods: "We measured end-to-end latency across regions using consistent routing and batch-aware execution. Cost estimates are derived from tokenized workloads representative of common production usage. Results are intended to show comparative trends, not absolute performance for any single customer workload."
---

press-bot: :white_check_mark: Sent; reporter confirmed they will hold to embargo.

social-ops: Noted  will prepare tweet + LinkedIn copy but holding until blog URL is live.

maya (head of growth): Thanks all. If any outlet says they'll publish early, tag this thread and we'll escalate to exec comms. Closing unless we hear otherwise.
